Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting public service announcements by elected officials during reelection campaigns.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting public service announcements byelected officials during reelection campaigns; adding a new section tochapter 42.52 RCW; adding a new section to chapter 42.23 RCW; andcreating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the ethics inpublic service act was enacted in order to make a distinction betweenpublic duties and private affairs, and that the use of one's publicoffice should not be used for personal gain or private advantage. Thelegislature further finds that public service announcements made byelected officials during their reelection campaigns are the equivalentof campaign advertisements and result in personal gain and privateadvantage for incumbents at taxpayer expense. Therefore, thelegislature intends that public service announcements made by electedofficials be restricted during reelection campaigns.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 42.52 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Except as provided in this section, during the period beginning p. 1 HB 2994January 1st of a reelection year and continuing through the generalelection, or until the official is no longer a candidate, a stateelected official may not make public service announcements. Thissection does not apply to public service announcements that are part ofthe regular duties of the state office that only mention or visuallydisplay the state office or state office seal or logo and do notmention or visually display the name of the state official in theannouncement.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 42.23 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Except as provided in this section, during the period beginningJanuary 1st of a reelection year and continuing through the generalelection, or until the official is no longer a candidate, a municipalelected official may not make public service announcements. Thissection does not apply to public service announcements that are part ofthe regular duties of the officer that only mention or visually displaythe office or office seal or logo and do not mention or visuallydisplay the name of the municipal official in the announcement.
